page.overview:
Who is Menenius Lanatus?

Menenius sas Lanatus is a character from Final Fantasy XIV. He is a Tribunus of the IVth Imperial Legion introduced during the Save the Queen story.

Menenius serves as the Legion's chief intelligence officer, recruiting and dispatching spies, gathering information, and providing counsel to Legatus Noah van Gabranth in all matters of war. He commands the archaeological mission to the southern provinces of Dalmasca and Bozja, seeking to gain technological knowledge and arcane reliquaries from Allag and Ivalice of power surpassing present-day knowledge.

In the days of the republic, the Lanatus family boasted a long and august lineage, until Menenius's grandfather, Thyrus, opposed then-dictator Solus zos Galvus. Banished, Thyrus died famished and in ignominy, but his son, Lucius, was taken in by the IVth Legion, which had been dispatched to the fringes at the time. Possessed of a sharp mind and aptitude for military strategy, Lucius earned the favor of Basch van Gabranth, who named the young man his second-in-command. Determined to restore his family's good name, Lucius, at his Legatus's behest, married an Elezen noblewoman of diminished circumstances, adopting her son as his own─this was Menenius.

When the Garlean war of succession broke out, Legatus Gabranth chose the path of independence, realizing his long-held dream. The IVth Legion ceased to receive provisions or reinforcements from the Empire, rendering their position precarious as their battle with the Resistance dragged on. Recently dispatched to Castrum Lacus Litore after this the Bozjan Resistance targeted this key strategic point, Menenius oversaw three armies: to wit, the beast army led by Lyon rem Helsos, Sadr rem Albeleo and his contingent of mages, and the tribunus's own pride and joy─a fearsome detachment of magitek warmachina.
